rationale: Stands. Every neighbouring pair is a state dependency on the current page. Save and close leaves the provider Inactive with status reason Validated, the only state where a trial ingestion runs, and Save as draft blocks all ingestion. The trial must come before activation, because it needs an inactive, validated provider and because activation starts ingestion and puts articles in search results, which the first requirement forbids before the check. Time-range ingestion needs Active with Ingestion Ready, and the page says to activate first. Check 1 reverse search: I searched Learn for integrated search provider pages and opened View and use insights for search providers, the Insights troubleshooting article and the msdyn_integratedsearchprovider table reference. None shows another order, and the table reference confirms that Ingestion Ready is the only Active status reason, while Validated and Draft are Inactive. The 30-day range is inside the 60-day limit. Both distractors fail for documented reasons. The evidence notes are accurate.
